lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You wake to the sound of a bell that should not be ringing.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The Spire room is cold. Dust hangs in the light. On the sill, a cup of tea has gone entirely still.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Ninth day.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You do not know how you know. The words are already there, the way a bruise is already there.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Cael. The Bell is cracking.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mara Voss stands in the doorway with soot on her sleeves and her jaw set. Below the Spire, all of Aurel is holding its breath.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: If it rings again, the day starts over. You know that. You always know that.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Then we have until noon.

choice.prompt: Mara holds out her hand. Above you, the Bell gives a sound like a tooth breaking.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Good. We do this together, or not at all.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Her hand is warm. The Bell cracks again, and somewhere below, a choir begins to sing.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: That is not a hymn.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: No. It is the Hollow Choir. It has come to finish the crack.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The Bell hangs above you like a held breath. A hairline of white runs through the brass, bright as frost.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Nine days. Nine chances.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Then stop counting and move. The Hollow Choir is already inside the wall.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Ember Row is usually loud by afternoon. Today the stalls stand empty, their awnings ticking in the wind.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: You are late, Bellkeeper.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Iven Sorn lowers his arbalest. He has the patient eyes of a man who has been counting exits.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Where is everyone?

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: The Watch closed the checkpoint at noon. Said the ashfall was unhealthy.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: He tilts his chin toward the foundry. Black smoke is rising in a column that does not bend.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: Elias went in to fix a counterweight. He has not come out.

choice.prompt: The foundry gates are shut. Somewhere inside, something heavy is striking metal.

choices.text: Ask Iven to come with you.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: I thought you would never ask.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: He checks his bow, then the door, then you. It is, you think, the closest thing to affection he allows himself.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Stay behind me.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: Not a chance.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You go in through the ash door. The heat presses against your face like a hand.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Behind you, Iven curses softly and follows anyway.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: You are going to get us both killed.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Probably.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Night comes to Aurel the way water comes to a hull. Slowly, then all at once.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: The crack held. For now.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: And tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Tomorrow the Bell rings again, and we begin again.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The three of you sit beneath the great brass mouth. Somewhere in the city, a child is laughing. It sounds very far away.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: We should remember this.

choice.prompt: The Bell will take the day when it rings. You can anchor one thing against the dark.

choices.text: Keep the warmth of this room.
Keep the crack in the Bell.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You hold on to the tea, the soot, the two people beside you. It is not a grand memory. It is enough.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, this happened.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You fix the crack in your mind: its whiteness, its angle, the exact note the Bell made when it split.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Next time, we go straight for the source.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: You let the day go. It leaves quietly, without ceremony, like a guest who knows they were never invited.

lines.speaker: Iven
lines.text: That is either wisdom or surrender.

lines.speaker: Cael
lines.text: Ask me on the ninth day.
